confirmed.issue: Mis-paired repair-vs-replace rule sources. The 50% cost rule is attributed to 'Kellow, Modernize, and Josten,' but per facts-materials-economics.md §8 the 50% rule's sources are WeatherShield/Home Depot; Kellow pairs to the 25%-area rule and Modernize/Josten to the 30% rule. The named set does not contain a valid 50%-rule source.

confirmed.suggestedFix: Re-pair per the packs: keep the 25–30% area rule to Kellow/RapidRestore and pin the 50% cost rule to WeatherShield/Home Depot — e.g. '...damage crosses 25–30% of the roof area, per Kellow and RapidRestore, or one repair nears 50% of replacement cost, per WeatherShield and Home Depot...'. Apply to both process[0] and faqs[0].answer.
confirmed.reasoning: The offending text is present exactly as described in both process[0] ("...one repair nears 50% of replacement cost, the contractor-consensus thresholds, per Kellow, Modernize, and Josten repair-vs-replace guidance...") and faqs[0].answer ("...or when one repair nears 50% of replacement cost, per Kellow, Modernize, and Josten..."). This violates the named-source mapping in facts-materials-economics.md §8 (and §85-92): the 50% rule sources are WeatherShield / Home Depot / industry (§305); Kellow / Modernize / Josten are the sources for the 30% cost rule (§306, §90), NOT the 50% rule; the 25% area rule sources are RapidRestore / MyQuoteIQ (§307). So the named set Kellow/Modernize/Josten contains no valid 50%-rule source — it is the 30%-rule trio mis-pinned to the 50% threshold. The gold exemplar (committed Orange combo) correctly attributes the 50% rule to "WeatherShield and roofing-industry guidance," and every committed sibling that states the 50% cost rule (Newark, East Orange, Orange, Belleville, Nutley, West Orange, Bloomfield, Glen-Ridge, Irvington) pins it to WeatherShield — never to Kellow/Modernize/Josten alone. Cedar-grove is the lone outlier mis-pairing the 50% cost rule exclusively to the NJ-blog trio. This is a real, fixable source-attribution defect, not a gold-voice match. No Cedar Grove COA/geography/entity-grounding facts are implicated (those fields are correct: COA NONE, advisory Heritage Advisory Committee, registered NJ HIC).
